title: A full hotel with room for one more

probes.question: True or false: a hotel with infinitely many full rooms can still fit one more guest.

sources.title: Hilbert's paradox of the Grand Hotel (Wikipedia)

image.alt: A long hotel corridor with a blue and cream patterned carpet and white panelled doors

body.claim: A hotel with infinitely many rooms, all of them full, can still welcome a new guest.
body.why: Ask every guest to move to the next room: the guest in room 1 goes to room 2, room 2 to room 3, and so on forever. Room 1 is now free. This is Hilbert's paradox of the Grand Hotel, a way to show how strange infinity is compared with ordinary counting.
